summary:
A square hall on a stone podium (x 8..143), ringed by 14 quartz columns a side on a 9-block rhythm in front of red terracotta walls, with a polished granite band and a gray eave beam. Over it sits a hand-profiled concave yellow hip roof (eave at y 24, flat top at y 41) with gray hip ridges and corners that flick up, lit by ochre froglight tiles set into the roof.
On the south front the eave lifts into a tall gray portal: two upswept fins rising to y 47, six tall columns and a lit glass lobby behind them, reached by broad accessible slab steps. These are the building's signature features. Square hall on a raised stone podium: 52 quartz columns, red walls with a granite band, a great yellow concave-hip roof with corner upsweeps, gold tips, and froglight tiles.
The south portal has a raised eave between two upswept stone fins, six tall columns, a lit glass lobby and a "SUN YAT-SEN" board.
Floodlit at dusk by shroomlight wells, gallery lanterns, chandeliers and lamp posts, with hedged lawns around the podium.

parts.name: podium, steps, colonnade, walls
parts.scope: podium(), step_ramp(), cheek_wall(), column() x52, red_wall_run() x4 with door-bay gaps, granite band y 20..21, eave beam ring y 22..23 and eave_bracket().

parts.name: great yellow roof
parts.scope: roof_shell() with the concave d-table, corner lift, hip_ridge(), corner_flick() with gold tips, top deck y 41 with rim and gold corners; skip the portal cut-out.

parts.name: south portal
parts.scope: fin() x2 (x 49..51, 100..102, up to y 47), six tall columns on z 134, portal_lintel() box y 37..40 with dentils, mid beam y 30..31; overwrites roof and short columns there.

parts.name: glazing and signs
parts.scope: glass_wall() at z 130 with mullions, transoms and open door pairs, door_bay() for E/W/N, name_board() x 64..87 y 32..35 z 133 with SUN YAT-SEN banner letters.

parts.name: dusk lighting
parts.scope: chandelier() x3 in the lobby, flood_well() at every column, gallery_lantern(), roof_light() 8-grid plus ridge feet, lamp_post() on cheeks and podium corners, fin-tip floodlights.

parts.name: grounds
parts.scope: lawn patches, hedge_run() z 144..147, topiary_cone() every 18, flagpole() x4, edge strips, only on # footprint cells.

recruit.why: Podium, 52 columns, red walls, pilasters, eave beams and the stone fins with their stepped flicks.
The concave yellow-tile hip with terracotta courses, ridges, upswept corners and gold tips.
Mullioned lobby glass, door bays and the gold-lettered name board.
Dusk floodlights, chandeliers, froglight roof lights and lamp posts, leaving no dark spawnable cell.
Hedges, topiary, lawns and flagpoles around the podium.
